prompt:
ONE original square 1024x1024 premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of HATHOR, the ancient Egyptian goddess in her documented heavenly cow form.
ANATOMY: One living female bovine, exactly one bovine head, two horns, two eyes and four legs; a HUGE METAL SUN DISK visibly nestled between the two horns, nearly as wide as her face. This is the sacred cow with stars above, emerging from papyrus. No human torso, no wings, no extra anatomy. [hathor-c10,hathor-c11,hathor-c15]
MOMENT: Thrust her head forward and down toward the viewer as she drives bodily through towering papyrus, one front hoof landing at the very bottom foreground, reeds bending and dark water splashing through direct contact. Forceful, awe-inspiring arrival of a goddess, steady authoritative stare into the viewer. Not grazing, not a peaceful farm animal.
POWER: No invented emitted magic or fire attack. Divinity is expressed through her documented disk and star-filled heavenly iconography; splashes and moving reeds come only from her physical advance. [hathor-c10,hathor-c11,hathor-c15]
SCALE & CAMERA: Extreme low camera at hoof level, wide-angle close framing; the head and horns occupy the upper TWO THIRDS of the square. Forehead almost brushes the viewer. Her deep chest and the receding four legs complete a coherent body; no tiny-human scale props or invented giant anatomy. Build overwhelming monumental presence through perspective, not added biological size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: ONE dominant golden backlight precisely behind the metal sun disk silhouettes the horns and rims her face; deep walnut shadows, suspended spray and a dark night sky showing crisp stars overhead. Disk is metal in backlight, not an energy weapon.
SURFACE: Dense dark russet hide, wet coarse hair, fine rough horn texture, ancient gold disk; avoid black-and-white dairy spotting. Rich painterly physical material, not plastic.
SETTING: Tangled papyrus thicket with shallow dark water; stars overhead. [hathor-c10,hathor-c15]
MOOD: Benevolent but overwhelming divine authority, awe-inspiring and imposing; never cute, placid, decorative, or ordinary livestock. Sacred devotional art, original composition.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glowing aura, neon outline or energy ribbons. No human spectators, no farm fence, no pastoral daylight.
depicted_variant: Sacred cow advancing through papyrus, face and solar disk dominating the low-angle frame.
rationale: Big names (major gods, archangels, demon princes, primordial monsters, famous literary beings) must look imposing and powerful: an epic, awe-inspiring or terrifying presence that matches their standing in the tradition.
aura: Overwhelming perspective and documented solar disk and stars (hathor-c10,c11); physical splash from motion only.
